title: The Inhibitory Effects and Cytotoxic Activities of the Stem Extract of Sarracenia purpurea against Melanoma Cells and the SsbA Protein.
authors: Liu, Hong-Wen; Chiang, Wei-Yu; Huang, Yen-Hua; Huang, Cheng-Yang
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦植物提取物对金黄色葡萄球菌单链DNA结合蛋白SsbA的抑制及黑色素瘤细胞毒性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和分子对接，但对象非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: The Staphylococcus aureus SsbA protein (SaSsbA) is a single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB) that is categorically required for DNA replication and cell survival, and it is thus an attractive target for potential antipathogen chemotherapy. In this study, we prepared the stem extract of Sarracenia purpurea obtained from 100% acetone to investigate its inhibitory effect against SaSsbA. In addition, the cytotoxic effects of this extract on the survival, apoptosis, proliferation, and migration of B16F10 melanoma cells were also examined. Initially, myricetin, quercetin, kaempferol, dihydroquercetin, dihydrokaempferol, rutin, catechin, beta-amyrin, oridonin, thioflavin T, primuline, and thioflavin S were used as possible inhibitors against SaSsbA. Of these compounds, dihydrokaempferol and oridonin were capable of inhibiting the ssDNA-binding activity of SaSsbA with respective IC50 values of 750 +/- 62 and 2607 +/- 242 muM. Given the poor inhibition abilities of dihydrokaempferol and oridonin, we screened the extracts of S. purpurea, Nepenthes miranda, and Plinia cauliflora for SaSsbA inhibitors. The stem extract of S. purpurea exhibited high anti-SaSsbA activity, with an IC50 value of 4.0 +/- 0.3 mug/mL. The most abundant compounds in the stem extract of S. purpurea were identified using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry. The top five most abundant contents in this extract were driman-8,11-diol, deoxysericealactone, stigmast-5-en-3-ol, apocynin, and alpha-amyrin. Using the MOE-Dock tool, the binding modes of these compounds, as well as dihydrokaempferol and oridonin, to SaSsbA were elucidated, and their binding energies were also calculated. Based on the S scores, the binding capacity of these compounds was in the following order: deoxysericealactone > dihydrokaempferol > apocynin > driman-8,11-diol > stigmast-5-en-3-ol > oridonin > alpha-amyrin. Incubation of B16F10 cells with the stem extract of S. purpurea at a concentration of 100 mug/mL caused deaths at the rate of 76%, reduced migration by 95%, suppressed proliferation and colony formation by 99%, and induced apoptosis, which was observed in 96% of the B16F10 cells. Overall, the collective data in this study indicate the pharmacological potential of the stem extract of S. purpurea for further medical applications.
abstract_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌SsbA蛋白（SaSsbA）是一种单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB），在DNA复制和细胞存活中具有绝对必要性，因此成为潜在抗病原体化疗的有吸引力的靶点。本研究制备了从100%丙酮中获得的紫瓶子草（Sarracenia purpurea）茎提取物，以研究其对SaSsbA的抑制效果。此外，还检测了该提取物对B16F10黑色素瘤细胞存活、凋亡、增殖和迁移的细胞毒性作用。最初，杨梅素（myricetin）、槲皮素（quercetin）、山奈酚（kaempferol）、二氢槲皮素（dihydroquercetin）、二氢山奈酚（dihydrokaempferol）、芦丁（rutin）、儿茶素（catechin）、β-香树脂醇（beta-amyrin）、冬凌草甲素（oridonin）、硫黄素T（thioflavin T）、樱草灵（primuline）和硫黄素S（thioflavin S）被用作可能的SaSsbA抑制剂。在这些化合物中，二氢山奈酚和冬凌草甲素能够抑制SaSsbA的ssDNA结合活性，其IC50值分别为750 ± 62和2607 ± 242 μM。鉴于二氢山奈酚和冬凌草甲素的抑制能力较弱，我们筛选了紫瓶子草、米兰猪笼草（Nepenthes miranda）和嘉宝果（Plinia cauliflora）的提取物以寻找SaSsbA抑制剂。紫瓶子草茎提取物表现出高抗SaSsbA活性，IC50值为4.0 ± 0.3 μg/mL。使用气相色谱-质谱联用技术鉴定了紫瓶子草茎提取物中最丰富的化合物。该提取物中含量最高的前五种化合物为driman-8,11-diol、deoxysericealactone、stigmast-5-en-3-ol、夹竹桃麻素（apocynin）和α-香树脂醇（alpha-amyrin）。利用MOE-Dock工具，阐明了这些化合物以及二氢山奈酚和冬凌草甲素与SaSsbA的结合模式，并计算了它们的结合能。基于S分数，这些化合物的结合能力顺序为：deoxysericealactone > 二氢山奈酚 > 夹竹桃麻素 > driman-8,11-diol > stigmast-5-en-3-ol > 冬凌草甲素 > α-香树脂醇。将B16F10细胞与浓度为100 μg/mL的紫瓶子草茎提取物孵育，导致76%的细胞死亡，迁移减少95%，增殖和集落形成抑制99%，并诱导凋亡，在96%的B16F10细胞中观察到凋亡现象。总体而言，本研究的综合数据表明紫瓶子草茎提取物在进一步医学应用中具有药理学潜力。
